summary: Full rewrite of Cyber Verification Program article: adds Mythos 5.2, tier table with seat caps, prohibited activities, review-time targets; removes eligibility-factors section.
safety_implication: Reduced cyber safeguards now extend to Claude Mythos 5.2; explicit caution about military/intelligence/law-enforcement customers and diversion risk dropped; CVP stated to leave non-cyber (e.g., biology) safeguards untouched.
notable: The rewrite quietly removed the published eligibility criteria (legal environment, diversion risk, military/intelligence customers) while extending reduced-safeguard access to a newer frontier model, Mythos 5.2.
